test_title: PYST 60: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Ajay starts from Point A and drives 20 km towards South. He then takes a left turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 30 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 10 km and stops at Point Q. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he now drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only.)
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Ajay starts from Point A and drives 20 km towards South. He then takes a left turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 30 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac9d44a7a5ab54854f518cdf9966d780f114b95bc0b2dfe8e8ebe61075f6e603.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8db8ba130c78571d0cd1449fb81ce3ced0d50196314d4d220bd9fe8f635056da.png] 

2) He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 10 km and stops at Point Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f09d3f54f684d55b24f4a125d3fbcffa56b14b3a81152ade6b35ecd59b7f4a6.png] 

Here, we can see that he needs to drive in West direction to reach Point A again.

Distance he needs to drive = (8 + 5) km = 13 km

Hence, the correct answer is **"****13 km towards West"**.
